candidates.core_provocation: Two colleagues in a magical memory-repair shop discover that their shared memory of becoming friends was stolen from someone else. If they restore the truth, one of them will lose every memory of the other—but if they leave the false memory in place, their friendship is built on a lie.
candidates.why_interesting: The story creates a painful choice between truth and the relationship that gives life meaning.

candidates.core_provocation: Two colleagues who collect memories from the dead find one showing that one of them will die before the end of their shift. They can prevent the death only by destroying the memory, but doing so will also erase the dead person's final proof that they were loved.
candidates.why_interesting: The characters must choose between saving a colleague and preserving a stranger's last emotional connection.

candidates.core_provocation: In a supernatural library, one colleague suddenly vanishes from every record except the other's memory. Each attempt to prove that the missing colleague existed causes another memory of them to disappear.
candidates.why_interesting: The escalating mystery turns remembering into an urgent, visible struggle against disappearance.

parsed.reason_for_choice: The library premise offers the clearest forward-moving tension: the surviving colleague must uncover what happened before every trace of the other is erased. Its supernatural rule creates concrete suspense while allowing a bittersweet ending about what memory can—and cannot—save.
